branded.why: A well-sold brand, but one supermarket brand among many, no part of a food culture of its own.

about.text: A hard Dutch cheese made in the Beemster polder north of Amsterdam, from the milk of cows grazing the polder's sea-clay grass. It is made by the CONO cooperative much like Gouda, with the curd stirred by hand and ripened under changing temperature and humidity.

sources.text: Its milk, polder, hand-stirred curd and makers, from this page.
